input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Section 21 meets the preferred position. The cap is expressly mutual and set at the greater of Fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the event and USD 1,000,000; "Fees" (§1.5) covers recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, so the base is meaningful rather than illusory. Section 21.2 excludes indirect/consequential damages mutually while confirming data restoration, replacement services, notice and incident-response costs are direct damages. Section 21.3 carves out (uncapped) confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP, and confirms Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees is not "damages" subject to the cap. Section 21.4 preserves the caps against failure of exclusive remedy, and §18.2 confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. No one-sided or hidden liability language appears elsewhere. No redline needed.
